theater: 寧夏靈州與河套故五原

battle.name: 靈州之戰
battle.theater: 寧夏靈州與河套故五原
battle.brief: 武德五年（622）十一月，梁師都遣弟洛兒引突厥數萬騎圍靈州，宗室靈州總管李道宗乘間出擊大破之，繼而逐走入居故五原的郁射設，斥地千餘里。卡面亞述長弓不在此役：圍城的騎兵不排攻城序列，只靠馬上角弓與游騎施壓，勝負仍決於出城反擊的時機。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述長弓是亞述軍隊制式的步兵遠射弓，與箭矢、箭袋及盾牌配套，主要供前排步兵在接戰前拋射，也可由車上射手與城防部隊使用。

countries: 622 年的靈州之戰，交戰的兩方是唐與盤踞夏州的梁師都，以及梁師都背後的東突厥。唐方的邊防由各州總管與行軍總管分區掌理：靈州屬朔方道，坐鎮者是宗室李道宗；同一條北方邊線上，弘州總管宇文歆與交州刺史權士通於九月擊突厥於三觀山，定州總管雙士洛於恆山之南、領軍將軍安興貴於甘州各破一陣；延州道行軍總管段德操則直接進攻梁師都的老巢夏州與石堡城。唐廷在武德初年兵制尚未定型，邊州之兵由州府團練、鄉兵、宿衛殘部與歸附蕃兵拼湊而成，馬匹尤其珍貴，須自河套牧地供給，弩機與箭矢則靠州縣武庫及長安、洛陽的屯貯下發。對面是梁師都：隋末起兵夏州，殺官據城，自稱帝、國號梁，以統萬城為都，靠定楊可汗與其子頡利可汗撐腰，其弟洛兒領兵。突厥一方以郁射設為代表，部眾散處五原、河套一帶，並不與梁師都合成一體，實際上是聯盟而非從屬。對唐廷而言形勢是兩面受敵：河北山東劉黑闥再起，主力東移，北線必然空虛，靈州與五原正是這道空隙上的缺口。
countriesEn: The Battle of Lingzhou in 622 was fought between the Tang and Liang Shidu, who held Xia Prefecture, together with the Eastern Turks who stood behind Liang. On the Tang side the frontier was divided among prefectural commanders-in-chief and expeditionary commanders-in-chief, each responsible for his own sector. Lingzhou belonged to the Shuofang circuit and was held by the imperial clansman Li Daozong. Along the same northern line, the Hongzhou commander Xuan Yuxin and the Jiaozhou governor Quan Shitong defeated the Turks at Sanguan Mountain in the ninth month; the Dingzhou commander Shuang Suoluo struck them south of Hengshan, and the Army General An Xinggui broke them at Ganzhou. The Yan Prefecture expeditionary commander-in-chief Duan Decao attacked Liang Shidu's own base at Xia Prefecture and Shibao City directly. Tang military institutions were still unformed in the early Wude years: the troops of the border prefectures were pieced together from prefectural militia, local levies, fragments of the imperial guards and surrendered tribal auxiliaries; horses were the scarcest supply of all and had to be drawn from the pastures of the Hetao region, while crossbows and arrows came from the arsenals of the prefectures and from the depots at Chang'an and Luoyang. On the opposing side stood Liang Shidu, who had risen in arms in Xia Prefecture at the end of the Sui, killed the officials, seized the city, proclaimed himself emperor of a state named Liang with the capital at Tucheng, and relied on the support of the Dingyang Khan and his son Jiali Khan; his brother Luo'er led the troops. The Turks, represented by Yusheshe, were scattered across Wuyuan and the bend of the Hetao and were not fused into a single force with Liang; the relationship was an alliance, not a subjection. The Tang court was therefore under pressure on two fronts: Liu Heitao had revived in Hebei and Shandong, the main body of the army moved east, and the northern line was necessarily left thin, with Lingzhou and Wuyuan exactly the gap left open in that thin line.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物有三組。第一組是守方李道宗：他是高祖李淵的從子，略陽公李道玄的從父弟，年少時已以武幹見稱。梁師都遣弟洛兒引突厥數萬圍靈州，他不在城外與騎兵硬撼，而是等包圍圈露出空隙便乘間出擊，一戰把數萬騎兵打散，隨後追出塞外，驅走入居故五原的郁射設，斥地千餘里；高祖聞捷，以他武幹比擬魏時任城王曹彰，於武德五年十一月乙酉封宗室略陽公道宗等十八人為郡王，並特進道宗為任城郡王。第二組是敵方：梁師都與其弟洛兒。洛兒領突厥數萬兵圍靈州，是此役的實際統帥；梁師都則在夏州與石堡城一線遭段德操追擊，二月石堡城一戰大敗，僅以十六騎遁走，繼而夏州東城被克，退保西城，數百人自守。第三組是同期在北方各處與突厥交手的唐將楊師道、宇文歆、權士通、段德操、雙士洛、安興貴，以及自始至終未出場、卻決定整個戰局走向的東突厥頡利可汗：正是他的出兵，才使梁師都得到外援，也使唐廷在河北無法兩面兼顧時被這股北方壓力牽制住。
peopleEn: Three groups of people matter in this war. The first is the defending commander Li Daozong, a nephew of the founder Li Yuan and the younger paternal cousin of Prince of Lueyang Li Daoxuan, who had already made a name for his martial ability while still young. When Liang Shidu sent his brother Luo'er with tens of thousands of Turks to surround Lingzhou, Li did not meet the horsemen in a set-piece clash outside the walls. He waited for the ring of encirclement to open and struck at that moment, scattering tens of thousands of riders in a single battle, then pursued them out beyond the frontier, drove off Yusheshe who had occupied old Wuyuan, and took back more than a thousand li of ground. The emperor heard of the victory, compared Li's martial prowess with Cao Zhang, Prince of Rencheng of the Wei, and on the yiyou day of the eleventh month of the fifth year of Wude enfeoffed eighteen imperial clansmen including Prince of Lueyang Li Daozong as princes, and made Li Daozong specifically Prince of Rencheng. The second group belongs to the enemy: Liang Shidu and his brother Luo'er. Luo'er, who led the tens of thousands of Turks around Lingzhou, was the actual field commander of this campaign; Liang Shidu himself was pressed by Duan Decao on the Xia Prefecture and Shibao City line, losing the battle of Shibao City in the second month and escaping with only sixteen horsemen, then seeing the eastern half of Xia Prefecture taken and falling back with several hundred men to the western half. The third group is the Tang generals fighting the Turks elsewhere on the northern front in the same year, Yang Shidao, Xuan Yuxin, Quan Shitong, Duan Decao, Shuang Suoluo and An Xinggui, together with Jiali Khan, the Eastern Turkic khan who never entered the field yet shaped the whole war: his intervention was what gave Liang Shidu foreign support, and what pinned the Tang down while they could not spare forces for two fronts in Hebei.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，是新亞述帝國步兵制式的遠射弓：弓身以木為芯，兩端包角，內貼筋腱，拉力全由角與筋承擔，弓形反曲，握把與弓角之間留有一段平直，因此同樣的射力能給出更短的行程與更快的回弦速度；它與箭袋、箭鏃及盾牌配套，前排步兵在接戰前列陣拋射，車上射手與城防射手也能取用。亞述軍隊另有以弓箭掩護重裝步兵推進的老例：先用密集的箭雨削弱敵陣與城頭射手，再讓披甲的盾牌方陣壓上。但這件兵器不在武德五年的靈州。同期真正出現在北方戰線上的是兩種弓：突厥騎兵所用的角木筋反曲小弓，弓身短、拋速快，能在奔馳中迅速放箭，但箭程有限，必須把戰鬥拉進數百步內解決；唐軍的弓弩系統則以弩補弓，臂弩與蹶張弩可由步卒踏弦發射，床弩架在城頭與陣前，提供比弓更長的箭程與更強的破甲力，另有飛石砲、雲梯、撞車、巢車一類器械留給段德操去攻石堡城與夏州。靈州城頭與出城隊伍真正倚重的，還有壞木、拒馬、壕溝、烽燧，以及步騎配合的出擊陣形。馬匹才是這場戰爭最硬的裝備：故五原一帶是河套牧地，斥地千餘里不只是土地，更是可以徵發的戰馬與牲畜來源。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the standard long-range bow of the infantry of the Neo-Assyrian Empire: a wooden core with horn wrapped round the two tips and sinew laid on the inner face, so that the whole draw is carried by horn and sinew; the bow is recurved, with a straight section between the grip and the limb tips, which allows the same draw weight to be delivered over a shorter stroke and with a faster recovery. It was used together with a quiver, arrowheads and a shield; the front rank of the infantry shot in formation before contact, and archers in chariots and in the defence of cities could take up the same bow. Assyrian armies also had an old practice of covering the advance of armoured infantry with arrows: a dense shower of shafts would weaken the enemy formation and the defenders on the walls first, and only then would the shielded phalanx press forward. That weapon was not present at Lingzhou in the fifth year of Wude. The two kinds of bow that actually appeared on the northern front at that time were these: the small recurved bow of horn, wood and sinew carried by Turkic horsemen, short in the limb and quick to loose, able to shoot from the gallop, but of limited range, so the fighting had to be pulled inside a few hundred paces; and the Tang system of bows and crossbows, which supplemented the bow with the crossbow, since the arming crossbow and the pedal crossbow could be drawn by infantry using their feet, while the bed crossbow was set up on walls and in front of the line, giving a longer reach and a heavier armour-piercing shot than any bow. Alongside these were the flying-stone catapult, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and the wheeled siege tower, machines of a kind left to Duan Decao for the assault on Shibao City and Xia Prefecture. What the wall defences and the sortieing troops of Lingzhou really relied on was felled timber, chevaux-de-frise, the ditch, beacon fires, and the sortie formation in which foot and horse worked together. Horses were the hardest material of this war: the old district of Wuyuan lay on the pastures of the Hetao plain, so the thousand li recovered were not merely land but a source of warhorses and livestock that could be levied.
tactics: 靈州之戰的戰術核心只有一句：不出城硬拼，等對手鬆懈再打。洛兒引來的數萬突厥騎兵是典型的遊牧式圍城，不填壕、不架弩、不排攻城序列，只把靈州團團圍住，靠騎兵機動與游騎劫掠施壓，試圖在唐廷兵力分散、河北未定的窗口裡逼唐放棄河套；按節氣推想，十一月已近隆冬，牧場上的馬群只能集中在水源附近，騎兵可以發力的時辰與路段因此更可預測，包圍圈也就更難長期維持。這種圍法有一個弱點：圈子拉得越廣越薄，兵力越分散，越難同時封住任何一個方向。李道宗等的正是這個空隙，一乘間出擊以精兵直穿包圍最薄的處所，把敵軍連人帶馬打崩，再乘勝追擊，把戰場推到五原，驅走郁射設，連帶收回牧場與水道。同一條邊線上的唐軍動作可互相印證：九月宇文歆在崇崗鎮邀擊突厥，斬首千餘級；十月唐廷詔齊王元吉討劉黑闥於山東，主力東移，正是北線空虛的寫照。對照進攻方：段德操對石堡城與夏州採取的是另一套——銳氣進攻、先破一城、乘勝追擊，遇突厥來救即奉詔引還。靈州之戰與夏州之戰同年並進，一守一攻，構成本年北方戰線的兩種樣板。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Battle of Lingzhou can be stated in one line: do not fight head-on outside the walls, wait for the enemy to slacken and then strike. The tens of thousands of Turkish horsemen brought by Luo'er conducted a typically nomadic investment of the city: no ditches filled, no crossbows raised, no assault columns formed. They ringed Lingzhou and exerted pressure through cavalry mobility and raiding parties, hoping that while the Tang court was stretched thin and Hebei was unsettled, the Tang would abandon the Hetao. Judging by the calendar, the eleventh month was already deep into winter, and the herds on the pastures could only be gathered near the water, so the hours and the stretches of ground on which the horsemen could operate became more predictable, and the ring was correspondingly harder to maintain over a long period. Such a blockade has one weakness: the wider the circle, the thinner its wall, the more dispersed the troops, and the harder it is to seal every direction at once. Li Daozong waited for precisely that gap, struck through the thinnest part of the ring with picked troops, broke the enemy formation of men and horses together, and then pressed the pursuit, carrying the fighting all the way to Wuyuan, driving out Yusheshe and recovering the pastures and watercourses along with him. The actions of the Tang elsewhere on the same front corroborate the method: in the ninth month Xuan Yuxin waylaid the Turks at Chonggang Town and cut off more than a thousand heads; in the tenth month the court ordered Prince Yuanji to campaign against Liu Heitao in Shandong, and the shift of the main force eastward is precisely what left the northern line thin. By contrast, Duan Decao's method against Shibao City and Xia Prefecture was of another kind: advance with concentrated momentum, break one city first, pursue the victory, and withdraw on imperial order when Turkic relief arrived. The battle at Lingzhou and the fighting at Xia Prefecture ran in the same year, one defensive and one offensive, and together they set out the two templates of the northern front for that year.
data: 留下數字的只有《資治通鑑》那幾筆。武德五年九月癸巳，交州刺史權士通、弘州總管宇文歆、靈州總管楊師道擊突厥於三觀山破之；同月丙申，宇文歆邀擊突厥於崇崗鎮，大破之，斬首千餘級；壬寅，定州總管雙士洛等擊突厥於恆山之南；丙午，領軍將軍安興貴擊突厥於甘州，皆破之。十一月乙酉，記梁師都遣弟洛兒引突厥數萬圍靈州，李道宗乘間出擊大破之；突厥與師都連結，遣郁射設入居故五原，道宗逐出之，斥地千餘里。高祖於是封宗室略陽公道宗等十八人為郡王，別立道宗為任城郡王。另據同年二月庚辰，延州道行軍總管段德操擊梁師都石堡城，師都以十六騎遁去，上益其兵，使乘勝進攻夏州，克其東城，師都以數百人保西城，會突厥救至，詔德操引還。推算方面：靈州治靈武，與故五原相距約六百里，騎兵三四日可到，因此乘間出擊必須在敵營收攏、巡騎稀疏的短窗口內完成，否則出城兵會被合圍吃掉。史書未載此役雙方的確切死傷，也未記載任何攻城器械的數目與規格，弓弩備了多少具、箭矢耗了多少束，一概無從核對。
dataEn: Only a few figures survive, all of them in the Zizhi Tongjian. In the ninth month of the fifth year of Wude, on the guisi day, the Jiaozhou governor Quan Shitong, the Hongzhou commander Xuan Yuxin and the Lingzhou commander Yang Shidao defeated the Turks at Sanguan Mountain. On the bingyin day of the same month Xuan Yuxin waylaid the Turks at Chonggang Town and broke them badly, cutting off more than a thousand heads. On the renyin day the Dingzhou commander Shuang Suoluo and others struck the Turks south of Hengshan, and on the bingwu day the Army General An Xinggui broke them at Ganzhou; all of these were victories. On the yiyou day of the eleventh month the record states that Liang Shidu sent his brother Luo'er with tens of thousands of Turks to surround Lingzhou and that Li Daozong struck out at the moment a gap opened and routed them; the Turks then linked up with Liang, sent Yusheshe to occupy old Wuyuan, and Li Daozong drove him out, reclaiming more than a thousand li. The emperor thereupon enfeoffed eighteen imperial clansmen including Prince of Lueyang Li Daozong, and separately made Li Daozong Prince of Rencheng. Another entry, from the gengchen day of the second month of the same year, records that the Yan Prefecture expeditionary commander-in-chief Duan Decao struck Liang Shidu at Shibao City, who fled with only sixteen horsemen; the court reinforced him and he pressed on to Xia Prefecture, taking its eastern half, while Liang Shidu held the western half with several hundred men, and when Turkic relief arrived the court ordered Decao to withdraw. On computed geography: the seat of Lingzhou was at Lingwu, roughly six hundred li from old Wuyuan, four or five days' ride for cavalry, so the strike into the gap had to be launched inside the short interval when the enemy camp was closing up and patrols were sparse, otherwise the sortieing troops would have been surrounded and destroyed. The chronicles record no exact casualty figures for either side in this engagement, and no counts or specifications of any siege equipment, so how many crossbows were held and how many arrows were spent cannot be checked at all.
cause: 這場仗有三層來由。第一層是梁師都本身：隋末他在夏州起兵，殺官據城，倚仗突厥，自稱帝、國號梁，把統萬城經營成一個西北割據政權，與唐廷勢不兩立；只要他存在，關中北面就永遠有一枚釘子。第二層是時機：武德五年唐廷主力東移山東去平劉黑闥與蕭銻之亂，北線與河套一帶兵力空虛，靈州守軍不多，而突厥精騎來去如風，正是最容易得手的一年。第三層是地理與資源的位置本身。靈州治靈武，扼黃河上游通道，向西接河西走廊，向北緊鄰五原、河套牧場；控制靈州與五原，就同時控制唐的西北門戶、往西域的道路，以及西北邊軍賴以維持的戰馬來源。梁師都需要這塊地方來脫離突厥自立，突厥需要它作為深入唐境的跳板，而唐廷在主力東調時無力兼顧，缺口就這樣形成。618 年以來唐廷數次派兵討梁師都皆未竟功，到這一年，收拾他變成了一場必須馬上打的仗。
causeEn: There were three layers behind this war. The first was Liang Shidu himself: at the end of the Sui he rose in arms in Xia Prefecture, killed the officials, seized the city and, relying on the Turks, proclaimed himself emperor of a state called Liang, turning Tucheng into a northwestern separatist regime permanently at odds with the Tang. As long as he existed, there was a splinter driven into the northern flank of the Guanzhong state. The second was timing: in the fifth year of Wude the main body of the Tang army had moved east to deal with Liu Heitao and the revolt of Xiao Ti, leaving the northern line and the Hetao region thinly held, the garrison at Lingzhou small, and Turkic cavalry able to come and go like wind. It was the easiest year of all. The third was the position of the place and of its resources. The seat of Lingzhou at Lingwu held the upper passage of the Yellow River, led west to the Hexi Corridor and pressed close to the pastures of Wuyuan and the Hetao plain; to hold Lingzhou and Wuyuan was to hold at once the northwestern gateway of the empire, the road to the western regions, and the source of the warhorses on which the frontier army depended. Liang Shidu needed this ground in order to stand apart from the Turks; the Turks needed it as a springboard deep into Tang territory; and the Tang court, unable to cover both while its main force was in the east, had left the gap open. Since 618 the court had sent troops against Liang Shidu several times without finishing the job, and by this year putting him down had become a fight that could no longer be deferred.
impact: 靈州之戰的直接後果，是唐廷在朔方道前線站穩了腳跟，也保住了西北的馬源。斥地千餘里之後，靈州與五原之間的牧場、水道回到唐的實際控制之下，邊軍徵馬不必再深入敵境；通往河西的通道沒有被切斷，唐的軍資與使節仍能沿黃河上游與河西走廊往來。同一年的夏州之戰則證明另一件事：段德操雖能一度攻破石堡城與夏州東城，卻因突厥來救而被迫放棄，說明唐在北線面對的不是一個可以一鼓消滅的敵人，而是一個有外援的聯盟。這也決定了往後十數年的用兵節奏：先守、再耗，待對方內部生變或援軍分心時才反擊，貞觀年間唐廷終於能抽出主力北擊，正建立在北線先站穩的基礎上。人物上，李道宗因這一戰進封任城郡王，成為唐初宗室以邊功進封的典型例子，也確立了他在北方軍中的位置；同一個人後來在安市城之役中與契苾何力爭功，攻城不下而遭貶，說明邊州名將的勝負同樣繫於一時的器械、協同與運氣，而靈州這一仗他贏在對手的鬆懈與自己的果斷。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the Battle of Lingzhou was that the Tang court gained a firm footing on the Shuofang front and preserved the source of its horses in the northwest. With more than a thousand li recovered, the pastures and watercourses between Lingzhou and Wuyuan returned to Tang control, and the frontier army no longer had to drive deep into hostile country to collect mounts; the road to the Hexi Corridor was not cut, and Tang's supply columns and envoys could still travel along the upper Yellow River and the corridor. The fighting at Xia Prefecture in the same year demonstrated something else: though Duan Decao could take Shibao City and the eastern half of Xia Prefecture for a time, he was forced to give them up when Turkic relief came, which showed that the Tang was not facing an enemy that could be destroyed in one stroke, but an alliance with outside support. This too set the rhythm of the following decade or more of operations: hold first, wear the enemy down, and strike back only when their coalition cracked or their allies were distracted. Only because the northern line was already secure could the Tang in the Zhenguan era detach its main force for a general offensive to the north. On the personal side, Li Daozong's advance to Prince of Rencheng made him a typical case of an imperial clansman raised by frontier merit, and fixed his place in the northern armies. The same man later, at the siege of Anshi City, competed for the credit with Qiebin Heli and was demoted for failing to take the city, a reminder that the fortunes of a famous frontier commander turn as much on the machinery, the cooperation and the luck of a single moment as on anything else; in the fighting at Lingzhou Li won on his opponent's slackness and his own decisiveness.
result: 結局是守方得手，但只到這一步。洛兒引來的數萬騎兵被乘間出擊打散，靈州之圍解除；郁射設被逐出故五原，斥地千餘里，牧場與馬源收回；李道宗因功進封任城郡王，唐廷在靈州、五原一線的邊界重新推回河套之內。梁師都卻沒有就此了局：他的夏州與石堡城仍在，突厥也仍在北方，翌年同一條戰線上梁師都部將辛獠兒引突厥寇林州，段德操再至夏州俘其民畜而還，吐谷渾則同時在洮、岷、芳諸州大舉寇邊，西北多線同時吃緊。可見靈州之戰是一場漂亮的邊州反圍，一場把敵人從自家門口趕走的勝利，而不是一場決戰；梁師都的勢力要到其後數年才被平定，東突厥與吐谷渾也在貞觀年間相繼被擊破，唐廷在北線真正完成由守轉攻，是在靈州站穩之後才辦得到的事。
resultEn: The outcome went to the defenders, but it stopped at that. The tens of thousands of horsemen brought by Luo'er were scattered by the strike into the gap, the siege of Lingzhou was lifted, Yusheshe was driven out of old Wuyuan, and more than a thousand li of pasture and horse country were recovered, pushing the Tang border back inside the Hetao. Li Daozong was advanced to Prince of Rencheng for his part, and the Tang boundary on the Lingzhou-Wuyuan line was restored. Liang Shidu was not finished off, however: Xia Prefecture and Shibao City remained in his hands and the Turks were still in the north. On that same front the following year Liang Shidu's general Xin Liaoe brought the Turks to raid Lin Prefecture, while Duan Decao again reached Xia Prefecture and returned with its people and livestock as captives, and to the west the Tuyuhun raided the prefectures of Tao, Min and Fang all at once, so the northwestern line was under pressure from several directions at the same time. The Battle of Lingzhou was therefore a fine relief of a border siege, a victory that drove the enemy away from the gates, not a decisive engagement. Liang Shidu's power was not broken off until some years later, and the Eastern Turks and the Tuyuhun were defeated in turn only in the Zhenguan era; the Tang court's real shift on the northern front from defence to attack was something that could be achieved only after Lingzhou had been held.
